Feistel Network.

Let $f: X \rightarrow X$ be a function

We construct a permutation $\pi : x^2 \rightarrow x^4$ as

$\pi(x,y) := (y, x \oplus f(y))$

$\pi(u,v) := (v \oplus f(u), u)$
UFC many rounds of 77 with independently keyed Fs
In a classic paper, Michael Luby and Charles Rockoff show that 3-round Feisted network instantiated w/ 3 independent keyed PRFs $\Rightarrow$ PRP.
